summary: Georgia Forestry Commission lookout in Worth County, listed with an elevation of 416 (no unit given); no source found on its history or present site.

notes_for_editor: Thin record. The tower list gives no elevation unit, so the story gives 416 with no feet or metre conversion. The only sources are a lookout-index page that gives just the name and county, and one row in a tower list. Two web searches and about five page reads found no source on build date, staffing, fires, fate, access or current condition, so the story is short and says only what the sources support. Record status and access 'unknown' were left unchanged. Possible confusion to check, not used in the story: Wikimedia Commons has a photo (CC BY-SA 4.0, uploaded 2015) of a different Georgia Forestry Commission tower labelled 'Worth County tower' at 128 Fire Tower Rd., Sylvester, the Worth County GFC office. No source links that tower to the Anderson City site, so no photo was attached. A modern Worth County Fire Rescue station is named Anderson City (heritageindex.org listing, not read); it is a fire station, not the tower.
